definitions: Any of the tubes forming part of the blood circulation system of the body, carrying mainly oxygen-depleted blood towards the heart.
A streak of a different colour or texture in wood, marble, or other material.
A lode of metal or mineral in rock.
One of the vascular bundles or ribs that form the framework of a leaf or the wing of an insect.
examples: Blood samples were taken from a vein in the arm.
The marble had prominent grey veins.
Miners discovered a rich vein of gold.
He spoke in a humorous vein.
The intricate veins of the leaf were visible.
